text.p: Commercial printer John H Harland Co said on Monday it was cutting its dividend by $0.72 a year.
"The board reduced the dividend from $1.02 to $0.30 per year in order to fuel long-term growth through acquisitions," the company said in its year-end earnings report.
Harland said it would pay a quarterly dividend of $0.075 per share on March 6 to shareholders of record as of February 20.
The company also said its restructuring, part of of plan to take the company to double-digit percentage earnings growth, was on track.

"Rebuilding the infrastructure is on target with all but eight of the plants scheduled for consolidation to close by year-end 1997. The balance of the plants will close by mid-1998," the company said.
